_about: Optional settings for No Cloud Media Center. The app reads this file at startup; delete it (or any key) to fall back to the defaults shown here. Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are ignored.
_title: Shown in the header and the browser tab. Make it yours: 'The Morrow Family Cinema'.
_tagline: A short line under the library heading on the home screen.
_sections: One entry per top-level media folder. 'path' is the folder name inside this shared folder; 'kind' is 'movies' (a poster wall of standalone films) or 'tv' (folder-per-show, then optional Season folders, then episodes). Add more sections freely - e.g. {"id": "kids", "label": "Kids", "path": "Kids Movies", "kind": "movies"}.
